title: Exact (m - 1)x Non-Clifford Rotation Reduction of Adaptive R_Z Peeling vs. m-Qubit QFT
claims: A full m-qubit inverse QFT_{2^m}^dagger requires C(m-1, 2) controlled fine-angle phase rotations (k >= 3), decomposing into (m - 2)(m - 1) single-qubit fine non-Clifford Z-rotations plus (m - 1) controlled-S gates.

Iterative adaptive R_Z(-phi_known) bit peeling requires 0 non-Clifford rotations at stages r = 0, 1 and at most (m - 2) single-qubit fine rotations across stages r = 2..m-1, achieving an exact (m - 1)x reduction in fine-angle non-Clifford rotations and zero 2-qubit controlled-phase gates.
favorable_controls: Register sizes m in {3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64} (31x reduction at m=32; 63x reduction at m=64)
